subject.title: fix(telegram): add chunkMode and blockStreamingCoalesce to config schema

question: Should Telegram’s flat `chunkMode` and `blockStreamingCoalesce` keys remain legacy migration input only, or become supported runtime configuration again?
rationale: Current doctor code and tests intentionally migrate these exact keys, while this PR reverses that contract by admitting them into the strict runtime schema.

options.title: Keep aliases migration-only
options.body: Do not merge the schema additions; align docs and startup recovery with the nested canonical configuration.

options.title: Restore dual-shape support
options.body: Approve permanent aliases only with defined precedence, documentation, and fresh-install plus upgrade coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep aliases migration-only
recommendation.body: Do not merge the schema additions; align docs and startup recovery with the nested canonical configuration.
